ideas.pitch: An automated compliance and risk discovery agent that parses infrastructure-as-code and cloud deployment logs using local graph intelligence and deterministic validators to catch security vulnerabilities before deployment.
ideas.title: CloudAudit AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the Cybersecurity and Cloud tracks by offering a practical, enterprise-focused utility that judges from industry can instantly understand and appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, ultra-fast semantic routing proxy that categorizes inbound API queries and dynamically directs them to specialized, cost-effective small language models or local models.
ideas.title: SemanticRoute LLM
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering by focusing on cost-efficiency and performance optimization, which stands out against basic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first code quality and security analyzer that runs static analysis combined with a compressed local model to perform security reviews without leaking repository data to external APIs.
ideas.title: EdgeCode Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals strongly to privacy-conscious enterprise judges in the Open Innovation and AI tracks by processing code completely on-device.

ideas.pitch: A visual workflow automation builder that translates business process diagrams into executed multi-agent workflows with built-in human-in-the-loop validation checkpoints.
ideas.title: AgentBPMN Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles the Automation track with a structured visual interface that makes complex AI agent interactions manageable and auditable.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge access management system that allows students to prove enrollment and eligibility criteria for campus resources or hackathon submissions without revealing personal credentials.
ideas.title: ZK-Gated Campus Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings advanced cryptographic techniques to the Cybersecurity and Open Innovation tracks, showcasing deep technical implementation beyond standard web apps.
